text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 城市天台.
Environment: City rooftop with bench, parapets, rooftop access and distant Seattle skyline.
Visual medium: otome 2d5d 3d; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Edit this existing 建筑图 of 城市天台. Preserve the scene artwork, colors, layout and panel arrangement. Correct misleading labels: REMOVE ALL cardinal directions, NORTH SOUTH EAST WEST and every direction arrow and compass, and all captions making a direction claim. Use only the scene name and ELEVATION heading. Keep white margins. No people or animals; replace any humans on posters with abstract nature artwork. No new scene elements.
